_comment: Offset guidance shown by action_carbon_offset_info. Lists real certification STANDARDS and their public registries rather than specific projects or prices, because project availability and prices change and the bot cannot verify them. The price range is a broad indicative range only and is presented as such.
principles: Reduce first: choosing rail over a short-haul flight cuts far more CO2e than offsetting the flight.
Offsets do not cancel emissions in the atmosphere at the time of travel; treat them as a contribution, not a licence to fly.
Prefer credits that are independently verified, retired in a public registry in your name, and that show additionality and permanence.

standards.name: Gold Standard
standards.notes: Founded by WWF and other NGOs; requires projects to show sustainable-development co-benefits.

standards.name: Verra Verified Carbon Standard (VCS)
standards.notes: Largest voluntary standard by volume; check the project type and vintage, as quality varies.

standards.name: Climate Action Reserve
standards.notes: North American offset registry with publicly listed protocols.

indicative_price_per_tonne_eur._note: Broad indicative range for voluntary credits; removal credits can cost far more. Always check the provider's actual price.
